brief: A 12-second feed ad for 'Noon', a vitamin-C and ceramide serum in a frosted amber glass bottle (30 ml) from a premium direct-to-consumer skincare brand. Launch offer: 20% off for the first week. Audience: women 25 to 35 who read ingredient lists. Tone: calm, precise, expensive. Brand colours: deep amber, bone white, a thin black line.

creative_brief.audience: women 25 to 35 who read ingredient lists
creative_brief.promise: Calm, precise radiance in every drop.

physical_subject.why_3d: frosted amber glass material, bottle shape and 30 ml scale

diagnosis: Place areas (PPA/RSC) dominate: the background scene swallows the message
Weak hook in the first 2 s (+0.22 → +0.97)
Attention network (IPS/FEF) is busy: several candidates compete for the eye
Reward/value areas (OFC/vmPFC) are low: no 'I want this' signal
directives: Simplify the environment: crop or blur the scene, put copy on a solid panel, let one subject own the frame.
Front-load the hook: the single strongest visual must be visible immediately at the top-left/center, not after a scroll or animation.
Make a single focal point: one hero element 2–3× larger than anything else; demote secondary cards and badges.
Make the benefit concrete and desirable: show the outcome (before/after, real numbers, price or scarcity), warm highlight color on the offer, social proof near the CTA.
